extracted.intended_audience: CIA Support Directorate staff preparing the annual OMB A-44 management improvement plan/report (internal agency managers and report compilers)
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare a consolidated Directorate report for the Agency's annual OMB Circular A-44 Management Improvement Plan/Report that documents management improvements and cost reductions, follows prescribed criteria and format, and supplies evidence to support defense of resource allocations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adhere to established reporting criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow the guidelines with respect to the criteria established for reporting accomplishments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The consolidated Directorate report should reflect the specific criteria laid out for documenting accomplishments; adherence to those criteria was singled out as a reason the report was commended. Ensure each reported accomplishment maps to the required criterion categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use prescribed format for presentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow the format for presentation specified in the guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The memo notes the consolidated report did an excellent job following the format for presentation; using the prescribed format will materially assist in preparing the Agency report to OMB. Maintain required structure, headings, and any ordering conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document concrete cost reductions and efficiency gains
rubrics_metrics.description: Demonstrate concrete efforts to reduce cost and increase efficiency in support and administrative areas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support and administrative costs are subject to severe scrutiny during resource allocation. Quantified, concrete evidence of cost reduction and efficiency improvements strengthens the Agency's ability to defend existing resources—provide metrics, before/after comparisons, or documented savings where possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consolidate Directorate accomplishments into the Agency report core
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure the Directorate's consolidated report captures accomplishments that will form the core of the Agency report to OMB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Individual Directorate reports should be assembled into a cohesive consolidated report whose contents are directly usable for the Agency-level submission to OMB. Emphasize completeness, consistency, and alignment with Agency reporting needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstrate broad participation and conscientious effort
rubrics_metrics.description: Show that individuals across the Directorate contributed conscientiously to management improvement and reports reduction efforts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The memo praises participation across multiple individuals and offices; document contributors and describe collaborative processes so the effort's scope and validity are clear.
